name: Nepal White Water Rafting
region: Multiple river systems (Central, Western and Far-Western Nepal)
sub_region: Trishuli (Dhading/Chitwan), Bhote Koshi (Sindhupalchok), Seti (Tanahun), Kali Gandaki (Parbat/Syangja), Sun Koshi (Kavre to Chatara), Karnali (Far-West)

difficulty.technical_grade: International river grades 2-5 depending on river and flow
difficulty.notes: Trishuli (grade 3+) and Seti suit beginners/families; Kali Gandaki 4-4+; Bhote Koshi, Sun Koshi and Karnali 4-5 (NTB). Grades rise at high water.

duration_days.notes: NTB: Trishuli 1-2 days (1-3 by operators), Upper Seti half day, Seti 2 days (Damauli to Trishuli confluence, ~32 km), Marshyangdi 2 days, Kali Gandaki 3 days, Bhote Koshi 1-2 days (~20-22 km), Sun Koshi 8-10 days (270 km), Karnali 8-10 days, Tamur ~10 days.

itinerary.route: Kathmandu - drive to Trishuli put-in (around Charaudi/Galchhi, ~3 h) - raft grade 3+ rapids - riverside camp
itinerary.notes: Example standard 2-day Trishuli trip; other rivers listed in duration_days.notes.

itinerary.route: Raft to take-out near Mugling/Kurintar - drive to Kathmandu, Pokhara or Chitwan
itinerary.notes: Trishuli flows toward Chitwan, so trips are often combined with a safari.

best_seasons.notes: NTB: trips usually planned Oct to mid-Dec and Mar to early May. Trishuli (and per operators Seti) can run in monsoon at higher grade; Sun Koshi, Kali Gandaki and Karnali are generally not run Jun-Aug.

guide_requirements: Raft with a licensed rafting agency and trained river guides (industry body: Nepal Association of Rafting Agencies, NARA). Long expeditions are fully supported self-sufficient camping trips.

flights: Karnali trips: Kathmandu - Nepalgunj (domestic) then drive to put-in
drives: Seti put-in at Damauli on the Kathmandu-Pokhara highway
logistics.notes: Multi-day trips camp on river beaches; Sun Koshi passes through remote country with no resupply.

highlights: Trishuli: Nepal's most popular rafting river, close to Kathmandu, runs toward Chitwan
Bhote Koshi: steep, fast, continuous whitewater 3 h from Kathmandu (near The Last Resort)
Sun Koshi 'River of Gold': 270 km, 8-10 days, rated among the world's classic big-water expeditions
Karnali: Nepal's longest river, remote far-west multi-day expedition
Kali Gandaki: deep gorges and riverside temples
risks: Swims and flips on grade 4-5 rivers
Remote evacuation on Sun Koshi and Karnali

secondary_keywords: best time for rafting in Nepal

unverified: 2026 river status after the 26 August 2026 Rasuwa flood (Bhote Koshi-Trishuli system): NARA announced Trishuli rafting resumed in early-mid October 2026 (Galchhi-Mugling section largely unchanged), but operator Paddle Nepal (10 Oct 2026) still had Trishuli on hold and Kali Gandaki not runnable; Lower Seti open. Confirm river-by-river before selling autumn 2026 dates.
Grades differ between sources (e.g. Seti listed as 2+-3 by one operator, 3-4+ by another; Bhote Koshi 4- to 5 depending on flow).
Karnali trip length: NTB says 8-10 days; operators list ~10 days.
